{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Bard]] 5, [[Cleric]]([[Animal Domain|Animal]]) 6, [[Harbinger]] 4, [[Shaman]] 5, [[Sorcerer]] 5, [[Spellsword]] 5, [[Warlock]] 5, [[Wizard]] 5 | Innate Level = 5 | Spell School = Transmutation | Descriptors = Chaos | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Medium (20 meters) | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = 1 round / level | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Will negates | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = The caster attempts to transmogrify a single humanoid creature. If their target fails a Will save, they are transformed into a harmless animal or beast that is selected on the spell radial menu. A target can only be affected by one Baleful Polymorph every ingame hour, and it is now removable by [[Console_command#-pray|-pray]] and [[Remove Curse]]. It is possible to self-cast savelessly, but cannot be removed with [[Console_command#-dispel|-dispel]].
While polymorphed, the target can only perform basic commands such as moving and cannot revert back to their original form at will. Also applies spell failure to prevent spellcasting. They are only able to speak in animal language.
| Notes = * None
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. * [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315213#p315213 Radial choice, hour cooldown, pray, remove curse, and self-cast] updated. * [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315363#p315363 chicken spell failure] update. }}

| Description = The caster targets a colossal area; summoned creatures of all types - familiars, animal companions, summons, undead, but NOT henchmen - caught in the area of effect must pass a DC or be banished. Creatures outside of their home plane are also susceptible to be banished are banished to the Hells, non-outsiders are banished back to the prime. A number of creatures equal to thrice the caster's level in HD can be banished. Blocks all summoning spells in the area where cast for 60 seconds; excluding animating undead creatures.
| Notes = The following ordered list are all the checks needed for the spell to work: #Target must be hostile #Target must be banishable (i.e: target is a summon or in non native plane) #Target does not have a "not-banishable" flag. #Target HD must be lower than the remaining banishment pool #Target is not a plot or immortal monster #Then it has to resist a SR check #Then it has to fail a save | References = * Removed [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315473#p315473 undead blocking] update. }}

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Bard]] 3, [[Cleric]] 3, [[Cleric]]([[Suffering Domain|Suffering]]) 2, [[Favored Soul]] 3, [[Hemomancer]] 6, [[Harbinger]] 3, [[Sorcerer]] 4, [[Spellsword]] 4, [[Warlock]] 3, [[Wizard]] 4 | Innate Level = 3 | Spell School = Necromancy | Descriptors = None | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Touch | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = Permanent | Counter Spells = [[Remove Curse]] | Saves = Will negates | Spell Resistance = Yes | Description = Applies one of the curses.
Curse Of Fatigue - Saving throw Fort: -4 physical ability drain.
Curse Of Kesefehon - Saving throw Fort: -10 to saving throws against disease.
Curse Of Hexxat Saving throw Fort: -6 to saving throws against poison.
Curse Of Slumber Saving throw Will: Sleep.

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Bard]] 6, [[Cleric]] 8, [[Druid]] 8,[[Favored Soul]] 8, [[Hemomancer]] 8, [[Sorcerer]] 8, [[Spellsword]] 8, [[Warlock]] 8, [[Wizard]] 8 | Innate Level = 8 | Spell School = Necromancy | Descriptors = None | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Medium | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = Permanent | Counter Spells = [[Remove Curse]] | Saves = Varies | Spell Resistance = Yes | Description = Provides ability to affect the target with one of the selected curses (radial spells).
Curse Of Exhaustion Saving throw Fort: -12 physical ability drain.
Curse Of Isolation Saving throw Fort: A Cursed creature is silenced, deafened, and turned to stone. Lasts 5 turns.
Curse Of Thanatos Saving throw Fort: On NPCs: Save versus death (Death Immunity is respected), reanimate if slain. On Player Characters: There is a 0.1% chance each. round to save vs the curse or die (Death Ward protects).
Curse Of Narfell - Saving throw Will: A Cursed creature is harmed by healing spells as if they were undead (and yet not healed by inflict spells)
Curse Of Sunstar Saving throw Fort: A Cursed creature becomes sun sensitive (similar to some races). !Currently works only against PCs.
Curse Of The Revenancer Saving throw Fort: On NPCs: The target is slain by a spirit. (Death Ward protects.) On Player Characters: After being cursed, any living creature killed by the victim had a small chance to come back as a revenant and zealously hunt down mortals until it is destroyed. Permanent. Player characters also receive a -4 penalty to Saving Throws against Death Effects. Requires Piety to cast.
Curse Of Zhengyi Saving throw PC Fort, NPC of Surge: On NPCs: The target is affected by a random blood arcana surge. (saving throw depends on the rolled surge curse). On PCs: Increases blood surge chance (allows it to affect all subjects). Applies -4 Penalty to Saving Throws against Curse Effects (Will save negates).
Curse Of Urfestra - Saving throw Will: Initial Affect target with Curse of Nightmares Temporary Secondary (only affects PCs): 25% chance on finished rest for Nightmares to materialize and claw at the victim. - Permanent | Notes = * None | References = * None }} [[Category:Spells]] [[Category:Necromancy School|8]] [[Category:Bard Spells|6]] [[Category:Cleric Spells|8]] [[Category:Druid Spells|8]] [[Category:Favored Soul Spells|8]] [[Category:Hemomancer Spells|8]] [[Category:Sorcerer Spells|8]] [[Category:Spellsword Spells|4]] [[Category:Warlock Spells|8]] [[Category:Wizard Spells|8]]

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]]([[Forge Domain|Forge]]) 9, [[Hemomancer]] 9, [[Sorcerer]] 9, [[Wizard]] 9 | Innate Level = 9 | Spell School = Conjuration | Descriptors = None | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Short (8 meters) | Area of Effect = Point | Duration = Concentration, 1 round / level | Counter Spells = None | Saves = None | Spell Resistance = No | Description = The caster creates a black blade-shaped planar rift, resembling a greatsword which fights at her side. The blade cannot be harmed by physical attacks, but it can be affected by dispel magic or similar effects. The spell requires the caster to concentrate on it — casting spells or performing any other action than walking or talking may result in a concentration failure and end the spell. Has permanent [[Haste (spell)|Haste]]. This spell will now always use the corresponding caster ability modifier for all classes, including Wisdom.
The spell cast from scrolls has a fixed AB of 32. | Notes = {{:Template:Summon Note}} | References = * None }} [[Category:Spells]] [[Category:Conjuration School|9]] [[Category:Cleric Domain Spells]] [[Category:Forge Domain Spells|9]] [[Category:Hemomancer Spells|9]] [[Category:Sorcerer Spells|9]] [[Category:Wizard Spells|9]] [[Category:Innate Spells|9]] [[Category:Permanent Effect]]

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Hemomancer]] 7, [[Sorcerer]] 7, [[Spellsword]] 7, [[Warlock]] 7, [[Wizard]] 7 | Innate Level = 7 | Spell School = Necromancy | Descriptors = Fire, Evil | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Long (40 meters) | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = 5 rounds (applies twice per round | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Special | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = With the dark words still on your tongue, a ray of black energy springs from your hand to wrap the indicated target in black flames that absorb heat rather than create it. The black fire crackles and hisses as they feed on their victim's life force and soul. A line of black fire shoots out from the caster's hands and towards their target. The target must make a Reflex saving throw.
On a failed save, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage and 1d8 Entropic damage plus an additional 1d8 to each damage type per 4 caster levels, up to a maximum of 8d8 Fire damage and 8d8 Entropic damage. The target also begins to burn for 2d8 Fire and 2d8 Entropic damage twice per round for the duration (Epic Spell Focus: Necromancy increases this damage by 1d4 + 1. On a successful save, the initial damage is halved.
Regardless of the result of the previous save, the Blackfire is a caustic and volatile spell, and enemies nearby the target must roll a Reflex save to prevent the Blackfire from spreading to them and inflicting half of the initial burst damage. Those targets it spreads to also begin to burn for the duration.
All enemies struck on a failed Reflex save, regardless if it is on the initial cast or spread from the initial target, become Sickened, receiving a -2 penalty to Fortitude saves. Sickened creatures must also roll a Fortitude save each round that they are affected by Blackfire Burning and, if they fail, become Nauseated(Daze) for 1 round.
| Notes = * Burning damage does not stack with Inferno, Hell's Inferno, and Cursed Lightning damage over time.
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. }}

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Paladin]] 1, [[Cleric]]([[Moon Domain|Moon]], [[Sun Domain|Sun]]) 1 | Innate Level = 1 | Spell School = Transmutation | Descriptors = Weapon Enchantment | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Touch | Area of Effect = Creature or Melee Weapon | Duration = 2 minutes per level | Counter Spells = None | Saves = None | Spell Resistance = No
| Description = You empower the touched melee weapon with some effects depending on the source of the Bless Weapon. You can target another creature to enchant its worn melee weapon. When targeting a dual-wielding character, if the primary weapon is already blessed, the off-hand weapon will be blessed instead. Non-restricted weapon enchantment.
'''[[Paladin]] Spell Book''' * Enhancement Bonus (Attack and Damage): :* Caster Level 1 -10: +1 :* Caster Level 11-15: +2 :* Caster Level 16-20: +3 :* Caster Level 21-25: +4 :* Caster Level 26-30: +5 * Damage Bonus Undead: :* Caster Level 1+: +2d6 divine damage vs. undead * Damage Bonus Outsider: :* Caster Level 13+: +2d6 damage vs. outsider * Damage Bonus Dragon: :* Caster Level 13+: +2d6 damage vs. dragon
'''[[Cleric]] Spell Book ([[Moon Domain]])''': * Damage Bonus (Undead): :* Caster Level 1+: +2d6 magic damage vs. undead * Damage Bonus (Shapechanger): :* Caster Level 1+: +2d6 magic damage vs. shapechanger
'''[[Cleric]] Spell Book ([[Sun Domain]])''': * Damage Bonus (Undead): :* Caster Level 1+: +1d8 positive damage vs. undead * Damage Bonus (All): :* Caster Level 1+: +1d8 fire damage :: '''''Note:''''' This damage bonus replaces any temporary essence
'''Stacking Rules''': * [[Cleric]] with both [[Sun Domain|Sun]] and [[Moon Domain|Moon]] Domains: :* Bless weapon's vs. undead damage will be either +1d8 positive '''OR''' +2d6 magical depending on the time of day :* Bless weapon's other bonus damage (+1d8 fire and +2d6 vs shapeshifter) will still apply

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]] 1, [[Favored Soul]] 1, [[Harbinger]] 2, [[Hemomancer]] 2, [[Warlock]] 3 | Innate Level = 1 | Spell School = Enchantment | Descriptors = Mind-affecting | Components = Verbal | Range = Close | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = 1 Round | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Will negates | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = You give the subject a single command, which it obeys to the best of its ability at its earliest opportunity. You may select from the following options. * Fall: On its turn, the subject falls to the ground and remains prone for 1 round. It may act normally while prone but takes any appropriate penalties. * Come: On its turn, the subject moves toward you as quickly and directly as possible for 1 round. The creature may do nothing but move during its turn, and it provokes attacks of opportunity for this movement as normal. * Flee: On its turn, the subject moves away from you as quickly as possible for 1 round. It may do nothing but move during its turn, and it provokes attacks of opportunity for this movement as normal. * Stay: The subject stands in place for 1 round. It may not take any action but is not considered helpless. * Sit: On its turn, the subject sits down for one round. It may not take any action but is not considered helpless. * Dance: On its turn, the subject dances for one round. It may not take any action but is not considered helpless. * Kneel: On its turn, the subject kneels in place for one round. It may not take any action but is not considered helpless.
If the subject can’t carry out your command on its next turn, the spell automatically fails (ie, status effect superseding it)
| Notes = * None
| References = * None }}

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Hemomancer]] 9, [[Sorcerer]] 9, [[Wizard]] 9 | Innate Level = 9 | Spell School = Transmutation | Descriptors = Blood Arcana | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Self | Area of Effect = Caster | Duration = 1 turn / level | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Harmless | Spell Resistance = No
| Description = The caster divides their current hitpoints in half to produce a homunculus constructed of blood. The homunculus will respond to commands as if a summon. Transmutation focuses will empower the summon beyond its basic capabilities similar to Conjuration focuses or Necromancy focuses for their corresponding summons.
The strength of the Homunuculus is further increased by the amount of HP consumed upon casting the spell. It can also be decreased if the amount of HP is too little. Only takes into account the damage you actually deal to yourself with the spell for the purposes of determining the tier. Consumes [[Hemomancer]] Blood Stacks as a buffer for the HP consumption requirement. Each Blood Stack will count as 10 additional hitpoints for the purpose of determining the Homunculus tier, making it easier to summon Tier 3 homunculi at higher blood stacks
Tier 3: 240+ HP and duration doubled Tier 2: 160-239 HP Tier 1: 90-159 HP Weakened: Less than 90 HP
| Notes = * None
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. * Duration doubled [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315213#p315213 update]. * Damage dealt [https://discord.com/channels/651879025643487242/652141193437642762/1090200920882679880 update]. * Hemo [https://discord.com/channels/651879025643487242/652141193437642762/1092473704056897536 stacks]. }}

revision.text:
{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]] 9, [[Favored Soul]] 9, [[Hemomancer]] 9, [[Sorcerer]] 9, [[Spellsword]] 8, [[Warlock]] 8, [[Wizard]] 9 | Innate Level = 9 | Spell School = Necromancy | Descriptors = Evil | Components = Verbal | Range = Personal | Area of Effect = Gargantuan (8.33 meters) | Duration = Special | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Special | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = The caster issues forth forlorn names of powerful curses. The area around the caster becomes damp with crimson vapor forming clouds. Before long a storm is unleashed with a single burst of power on everyone within its premise. Those unfortunate to be caught in the storm risk being subjected to one of the curses raging within the region. If the caster has Epic Spell Focus Necromancy, the size of the area increases to Colossal.
The curse is picked at random from the following list:
Curses (announced via floating text): 1 - Curse of Rot - Fort Save - Death - Neglects immunity to death effects, uses disease immunity instead. Instantaneous. 2 - Curse of Despair - Fort Save - 3d6 bleeding damage per round (Does not stack). Healing spells harm. Inflicting spells heal. 1 round /3 CL. 3 - Curse of Isolation - Fort Save - Petrify, Silence, Blindness/Deafness. 1 turn /3 CL. 4 - Curse of Exhaustion - Fort Save - d4+6 Attribute and 1d4+1 Level drain. Instantaneous. 5 - Curse of Paranoia - Will Save - Panic(Fear) - 10 rounds. If the creature is still feared at the end of the duration it receives d6(CL) psychic damage (no damage if immune to fear / immune to mind-affecting). 6 - Curse of Madness - Will Save - 3d6 psychic damage per round. (Does not stack). Confusion. 1 round /3 CL. 7 - Curse of Nightmares - Will Save - Sleep - If the creature is not awake in 10 rounds is subjected to a Nightmare effect (d10(CL) psychic damage). 10 rounds. 8 - Curse of Misfortune - No Save - -2 penalty on attack rolls, armor class, saving throws, and skill checks. 10 rounds. (Does not stack). Breaches 1 effect (save-less): 2 effects with ESF: Necromancy.
| Notes = * None
| References = * None }}

| Description = Limbs of a thalassic horror break through a gash in reality, reaching for the target. If the caster succeeds at a ranged touch attack, the target gets pulled to a nearby location soon after.
| Notes = * Creatures larger than Huge, creatures affected by Freedom or Respite are impervious to the effects of this spell, as are creatures that have been affected by [[Dark Undertow]] within the last 5 rounds. * Targets able to to apply [[Freedom of Movement]] before getting pulled can escape the tentacles. * No ranged touch attack is necessary for this spell to affect party members, nor will Freedom prevent the effects in this case. * [[Dark Undertow]] intentionally cannot be scribed, nor cast from scrolls.

| Description = The caster afflicts the target (comprised of blood or water) with a horrible, desiccating curse that deals 1d6+1 per 3 character levels (maximum 1d6+5) of Constitution damage. Oozes and plants are particularly susceptible, and receive 1d8 +1 per 3 character levels (maximum 1d8+5) of Constitution damage instead. Targets also have their water reduced by 1d20% on a failed save.
On a successful save, the target instead receives 1d6 damage per 5 caster levels or 1d8 per 5 caster levels if it is an ooze or a plant subtype. Their water status is also drained by 1d10% on a successful save.
| Notes = * None
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. }}

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Elementalist]] 9 | Innate Level = 9 | Spell School = Evocation | Descriptors = None | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Long (40 meters) | Area of Effect = Huge (6.67 meters radius) | Duration = Instantaneous | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Will partial | Spell Resistance = Yes | Description = You invoke a potent explosion to crush your foes. All creatures within the selected area will take d6+1 per caster level (max 30d6+30) damage (Will halves) and are potentially dazed for d3 rounds (Will negates). Damage type depends on Elementalist's chosen element. Daze will apply when Focus > 50.

Enemies struck by Elemental Annihilation are immune to the spell for 1 round.

'''Damage Special:''' Targets with Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Minor_Globe_of_Invulnerability|minor globe of invulnerability]] receive 25% less damage, and those with Improved Evasion; or under the effect of the [[Globe_of_Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]] receive 50 less damage. The calculation is applied before the main saving throw which can further halve the outcome.

'''Daze Special:''' Targets with Improved Evasion or under the effect of globe of invulnerability won't be dazed. | Notes = {{:Template:Damage_Spells}} | References = * None }} [[Category:Spells]] [[Category:Evocation School|9]] [[Category:Elementalist Spells|9]] [[Category:Innate Spells|9]] [[Category:Will Save]]

{{EpicSpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]] 21, [[Druid]] 21, [[Favored Soul]] 21, [[Shaman]] 21 | Spellcraft Prereq = 24 | Innate Level = 10 | Spell School = Transmutation | Components = Somatic | Range = Personal | Area of Effect = Large (5 meters radius) | Duration = Instantaneous | Saves = Harmless | Spell Resistance = No
| Description = The caster enters a stance in which they are wreathed in elemental fury at the expense of summoning capability. Elemental type is dependent on the current elemental stream, if no stream is selected then one of the four basic elements will be chosen. Epic spells are not affected by arcane spell failure from armor, nor can they be interrupted, countered, or dispelled. Upon activating the feat you are 'wreathed in elements' gain a plethora of bonus stats whose values vary and depend on your active elemental stream (see below), "all of the caster's summons are immediately dismissed and new summons are prevented while the stance is active".
: '''ELEMENTAL AVATAR STANCE''' :* Applies a series of bonuses based on stream (see below), as well as an AoE damage aura that procs once per round :* Dismisses all of player's summons and prevents summoning by them :* Applies a -30 to hide and move silently while active :* Drains 0.1% piety per round while active :* Levels in monk set the bonus AC to 0 :* Cannot be used with shape change :* Activating divine might or shield while active deactivates elemental avatar and vice versa :* Cannot be used with defensive stance :* The cooldown (CD) after stance is toggled off is now 12 seconds.
: '''ELEMENTAL STREAM STATS''' :* AIR ::* 2/- Damage Resistance ::* +5 Shield AC ::* +4 Regeneration ::* d4+2 Electric damage applied to weapon ::* 3d4 Electric damage aura
:* EARTH ::* 6/- Damage Resistance ::* +1 Shield AC ::* +4 Regeneration ::* d4+2 Acid applied to weapon ::* 3d4 Acid damage aura
:* FIRE ::* 4/- Damage Resistance ::* +3 Shield AC ::* +2 Regeneration ::* d6+3 Fire damage applied to weapon ::* 3d6 Fire damage aura
:* WATER ::* 4/- Damage Resistance ::* +3 Shield AC ::* +6 Regeneration ::* d2+1 Cold damage applied to weapon ::* 3d2 Cold damage aura ::* Hide/move silently malus reduced to -15 ::* Applies its 6 regeneration to allies in its aura ::* Aura is one size step bigger than other elemental streams.
| Notes = * The dice portion of the bonus damage is applied directly to weapons and fists and thus respects defensive essences and does not work on ranged weapons and does not stack with pre-existing damage on the weapon of the same type (ie d8 fire damage on a weapon won't stack with the d6 fire on the fire stream). * The added portion of the damage is applied directly to the character. This means it works on all items, including ranged weapons and stacks, with all damage bonuses on items. * This spell will be able to be taken by warpriest.
| References = * [[https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=45461 | Live Release]] }}

All creatures within the selected area will take damage (will reduces the damage to d4s) and are potentially dazed for 1 round (Will negates). The impact has a chance to lower the reflex save of the targets for 1 round (-2). Damage type depends on [[Elementalist|Elementalist's]] chosen element; damage is d6 per caster level (max 20d6).

The calculation is applied before the main saving throw which can further halve the outcome.

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]]([[Air Domain|Air]], [[Earth Domain|Earth]], [[Fire Domain|Fire]], [[Ooze Domain|Ooze]], [[Water Domain|Water]]) 9, [[Druid]] 9, [[Shaman]] 9 | Innate Level = 9 | Spell School = Conjuration | Descriptors = Air, Earth, Fire, Ooze, Water | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Medium (20 meters) | Area of Effect = Point | Duration = 24 hours | Counter Spells = Dismissal | Saves = None | Spell Resistance = No

:* Air Stream: ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Greater Air Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Elder Air Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]]) ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Huge Air Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Greater Air Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]])
:* Earth Stream: ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Earth|Greater Earth Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Elder Earth Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]]) ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Earth|Huge Earth Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Greater Earth Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]])
:* Fire Stream: ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Fire|Greater Fire Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Elder Fire Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]]) ::* 2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Fire|Huge Fire Elemental]] (2 [[Summons#VII-IX_-_Air|Greater Fire Elemental]] - with [[Feat_changes#Spell_Focus:_Conjuration|GSF: Conjuration]] OR [[Cleric]] [[Animal Domain]] OR [[Vermin Domain]]))

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Hemomancer]] 7 | Innate Level = 7 | Spell School = Evocation, Necromancy | Descriptors = Blood Arcana, Evil, Fear, Death | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Short (8 meters) | Area of Effect = Single, Large (5 meters radius) | Duration = Instantaneous, Demoralization and Fear 10 rounds | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Fortitude half, Will negates (special) | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = You attempt to twist and crush the life out of the target, turn them into a gory explosion that splatters their blood as rain- bringing forth terror. You deal 5 times your caster level damage (with a small element of randomness), half is Bleeding (Or entropy, if target is immune to bleeding), and half is Negative. Fortitude saving throw halves the damage.
Damage is empowered: by 30% if used on a near-death target (below 20% max HP). by 30% if used on target under a FEAR effect. Empowerments stack to 60% if the target is both near death and under the FEAR effect.
Blood Stacks: When cast with 5 or more Blood Stacks, the DC of the spell improves by 1. When cast with 10 Blood Stacks the subject has to pass Will save against FEAR or die (Immunities to Fear, Mind-Affecting, and Death effects ward the subject from this effect). Blood Stacks are consumed when the spell is cast using 10 stacks.
If the target (Not immune for bleeding damage) dies from the spell: For the next 9 seconds, the spell can be cast without Focus cost. All creatures within the zone will be demoralized (-2 AC, -2 AB, -2 Saves, -4 Skills) - Will save against Fear negates the penalty. All creatures within the zone who WERE already demoralized will be panicked (fear) instead. - Will save against Fear negates the penalty. All creatures within the zone who WERE already under the fear effect will be slain. - Fortitude saves against Fear negates the penalty (Death immunity is respected).
Special: Does not work on: Objects, Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, and Undead (except vampires). Does not work on creatures under etherealness. Bleeding damage is resisted by being immune to critical damage. Scales with SF Evo or SF Necro.
| Notes = {{:Template:Damage_Spells}}
| References = * None }}

| Description = A twisting pattern of discordant, coruscating colors weaves through the air, affecting creatures within it. The spell affects a total number of Hit Dice of creatures equal to your caster level (maximum 20). Hit Dice remaining that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted and the spell is spent. The spell affects each subject according to its Hit Dice: 6 or less Unconscious for 1d4 rounds, stunned for 1d4 rounds, confused for 1d4 rounds. 7 to 12 Stunned for 1d4 rounds, confused for 1d4 rounds. 13 to 20 Confused for 1d4 rounds. | References = * None }}

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Sorcerer]] 7, [[Spellsword]] 7, [[Warlock]] 7, [[Wizard]] 7 | Innate Level = 7 | Spell School = Illusion | Descriptors = Mind Affecting | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Medium (20 meters) | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = 1 round / level | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Will negates | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = The caster manipulates the senses of one creature so that it perceives itself to be the only real creature in all of existence and everything around it to be merely an illusion.
If the target fails its save, it is convinced of the unreality of every situation it might encounter. It takes no actions, not even purely mental actions, and instead watches the world around it with bemusement. The subject becomes effectively helpless and takes no steps to defend itself from any threat, since it considers any hostile action merely another illusion. The target also has feedback and blind applied to the target better simulate the effects of the spell.
| Notes = * None

{{SpellBookPage | Spell Level = [[Cleric]] 8, [[Druid]] 8, [[Favored Soul]] 8, [[Shaman]] 8, [[Sorcerer]] 8, [[Warlock]] 8, [[Wizard]] 8 | Innate Level = 8 | Spell School = Necromancy | Descriptors = Death | Components = Verbal, Somatic | Range = Touch | Area of Effect = Single | Duration = Instantaneous | Counter Spells = None | Saves = Fortitude | Spell Resistance = Yes
| Description = The caster attempts to stop a living creature's heart. This spell does not affect creatures that do not have a properly functioning heart, such as undead or creatures with Deathless Mastery, nor creatures that lack a proper circulatory system, such as Golems. Additionally, creatures who have achieved Perfect Self are capable of using Ki to restart their heart before it stops, and will not be rendered unconscious by this spell. They will still receive all expected damage otherwise.
The subject must make a Fortitude saving throw. On a failure, the target can only function normally for 2 rounds as their heart slowly stops beating, receiving 2d8 Magical damage each round leading up. After 2 rounds, they are reduced to 0 hit points and begin to die. On a successful fortitude save, the target instead receives 1d8 Magical damage per 3 caster levels. Since this spell does not produce an instant death effect, Stop Heart circumvents the protection granted by Death Ward.
| Notes = * None
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. }}

| Description = An invisible hand reaches out from the caster, grabbing the subject's throat and strangling them. The target makes a Reflex save. If they fail, the target is restrained and can't speak or cast spells with verbal components. If the caster attempts to do anything else while the spell is active, their concentration may break and the spell may end. The spell takes no effect against creatures that do not need to breathe, like oozes, elementals, undead, constructs, air genasi. The target receives feedback about the effect.
| Notes = * None
| References = * Added in the [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=314994#p314994 SPELLMAGEDDON: PART TWO] update. * Saves [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315213#p315213 updated] to remove fortitude. * [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?p=315363#p315363 Force choke] update. }}

| Description = A wave of divine energy blasts all enemy creatures within the area of effect. Enemies level 4 or less: death, 5 to 7: stunned, confused, and blinded, 8 to 11: stunned and blinded, 12 or higher: blinded. Any hostile summoned creatures are returned to their home planes.
| Notes = * [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/viewtopic.php?t=47665 Word of Faith destroys summons, even if the wording implies they are being banished], bypassing a [[Ward]] effect.

revision.comment: Updated the note about Monk Wis AC to be Ki Barrier
revision.text:
{{SystemsNav|title={{PAGENAME}}}}
{{#ifexist: {{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat | {{:{{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat }} | Under construction.}}
( [[{{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat|View]] - [{{fullurl:{{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat|action=edit}} Edit Feat] )
==Notes== * Does not stack with [[Ki Barrier]] wisdom Monk AC bonus. The higher of the two values applies. * Disabled on [[Favored Soul]], [[Invoker]], and [[Warlock]] with a Tier 3 Pact. * AC Bonus disabled for [[Druid]] while in Plant Shape. * [[Harbinger]] can take Divine Shield if they have taken the Divine Patronage class feat. * If a character has [[Epic Dodge]] then the armor class bonus is halved. * The [[Vigilante]] Vigilance Path's [[Ki Barrier]] passive AC does not stack with Divine Shield. Activating Divine Shield will deactivate the active element of Ki Barrier, and vice versa. * Activating [[Elemental Avatar]] will deactivate Divine Shield and vice versa. * [[Tenser's Transformation]] will fail if Divine Shield is active and vice versa. * Harbingers with the [https://wiki.nwnarelith.com/Harbinger#Hexes| Hex of Oath-Breaker] class feat can randomly remove Divine Shield from its hexed target. ==References== * Extensively [https://forum.nwnarelith.com/search.php?keywords=divine+shield&t=25&sf=msgonly updated]. [[Category:Feats]] [[Category:General Feats]]

( [[{{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat|View]] - [{{fullurl:{{ucfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}/feat|action=edit}} Edit Feat] )
== Notes == * Area of effect:A radius of 20 [https://nwn.fandom.com/wiki/Meter meter]s, centered on the turner. '''Hostile''' and '''Seen''' creatures are affected from nearest to furthest. *Turn undead has a HD cap based on the HD of the creature. Outsiders (if your domains allow you to turn them) add their SR (or half their SR if you have the Planar Turning feat) to this check. * This cap, (henceforth Power) is: '''Class bonus''' + 1d6 + Cha mod + Improved Turning Feat Bonus (1d6) + 1d2 per oath of inquisition. **Class bonus is the sum of [[Cleric]], [[Divine Champion]], [[Favored Soul]], [[Dirgesinger]], [[Blackguard]] and [[Paladin]] class levels. **[[Harper]] and [[Zhentarim]] adds half their level (rounded down, as normal). If they are priests, they also add +3, for a maximum total of +5. *A character is subject to turning if your domains permit it, and if its HD is lower than your remaining power. Every affected creature lowers the remaining HD of creatures that can be affected, but not the overall intensity of the effects. * An affected creature cannot be cured with the [[Restoration]] or Mind Protection (e.g. [[Clarity]]) lines of spells. However, the effect may be [https://nwn.fandom.com/wiki/Dispel dispelled], with the turner's hit dice as the effective caster level of the turn effect. '''Player Characters Turning''' *Player Characters that are affected are always struck with the custom Frighten effect - its intensity is equal to (remaining power - target HD)/2 , capping at 10 with a minimum of 2. This effect has a duration of 5 rounds. *Affected Player Characters are also struck with 12 seconds of a special effect that prevents them from targetting the Turner. *Player characters have an immunity period of 60 seconds after being affected. *Affected Player Characters will never show any VFX. '''Non Player Characters Turning''' * If turner has a domain giving the Command power and power is twice that of the HD of the target creature and turner has less than 3 henchmen, the creature will be turned into a henchmen. * If power is twice that of the HD of the target creature, it is destroyed, or it wanders away disappearing solemnly into the horizon. * If it is not but it's still above its HD, it will instead be Rebuked (immobilized) or struck with the custom Frighten effect for a duration of 5+Power rounds at max intensity (10). The effect can vary depending on your alignment. * If turner has a domain giving damage, Turn Undead Power is also used to determine the effect of Domains that damage creatures. {| class="wikitable" |- !
